t2.thesis: RDDT enters a high-volatility print (implied move ~13%) after a sharp pre-earnings drawdown that lowers the bar, but slowing US user growth and guidance worries offset that, leaving the outcome near the base rate.
reasons: Base rate for AMC and software_internet events is about 54%, so there is no strong cluster or session tilt.
The stock is down about 38% over 12 months, about 9% over the past week and about 48% off its 52w high, so expectations are reset and short interest is 14.9%.
Fundamentals are strong: revenue growth of 61%, a 29% operating margin, a forward PE near 14, upward EPS revisions and a record of beating estimates.
Concerns are real: US DAUq growth is only 6% and flat sequentially, Q3 guidance implies deceleration, and the last print fell 18% despite a 30% EPS beat.
Options price a 13% move with a nearly symmetric call and put IV, so there is no directional signal.
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue and EBITDA guidance versus buy-side expectations, together with US DAUq trends and search-traffic dependence.

prior.from: I3 overall validation t0_hit 0.542; AMC 0.538; software_internet cluster 0.541

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. Today is 2026-10-28, so the 2026-10-29 earnings report hasn't happened yet, and I have no information on how RDDT's stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down about 1 point from 0.54: the pre-earnings selloff and low valuation are a small positive, but the negative reaction to the last print despite a beat and the slowing-growth narrative offset it.

theses.expected: Rise: guidance is strong and the depressed setup triggers a relief rally.
theses.mechanism: Short covering and a low bar after the drawdown, with a revenue beat and Q4 guide above consensus.
theses.wrong_if: Q4 revenue guidance implies growth deceleration below about 50% or US DAUq declines.

theses.expected: Fall: the beat is not enough because decelerating user growth caps the multiple.
theses.mechanism: As in July, a beat with in-line guidance sells off; the market focuses on US DAUq and search algorithm risk.
theses.wrong_if: US DAUq reaccelerates and guidance is well above the top of the Street range.

theses.expected: Large move either way with a coin-flip direction at the open.
theses.mechanism: Implied volatility of about 175% leaves direction near the base rate.
theses.wrong_if: The realized move is under 3% and drifts in line with the broader market.
